Fast meta-map lookup and removal with probe-sequence repair and lock updates.

# Purpose
This C file implements the `fd_vinyl_meta` hash map specialisation by defining the map key, element type, key compare function, hash function, and element life-cycle macros, then including the generic map template from `fd_map_slot_para.c`. It therefore provides the concrete meta-table implementation used by the vinyl data structure, with memoized keys and slot-based open addressing. The file also defines [`fd_vinyl_meta_query_fast`](<#fd_vinyl_meta_query_fast>), which searches the meta table by starting from the memoized hash position and scanning forward until it finds the key or an empty slot.

The file also defines [`fd_vinyl_meta_remove_fast`](<#fd_vinyl_meta_remove_fast>), which removes an element from the meta table while preserving probe sequences for other elements. To do this, it finds the contiguous occupied range that starts at the removed slot, locks the affected lock range, clears the target slot, and shifts later elements backward when needed so that lookups still work. The function also contains hooks for updating the related `fd_vinyl_line_t` entry when an element moves, and it uses corruption checks to stop on invalid table state.
